import csv
import io


_FIELDNAMES = ("ticket_id", "summary", "owner")


def export_tickets(rows):
    """Export ticket rows using the project's semicolon-delimited CSV format."""
    output = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.DictWriter(
        output,
        fieldnames=_FIELDNAMES,
        delimiter=";",
        lineterminator="\r\n",
        extrasaction="ignore",
    )
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return output.getvalue().encode("utf-8-sig")

from exports import export_tickets


def test_export_tickets_format_and_escaping():
    rows = [
        {"owner": "张三", "ticket_id": 42, "summary": '修复;他说 "现在"\n重试', "extra": "忽略"},
        {"ticket_id": "T-2", "summary": "无 owner"},
    ]
    expected = (
        '\ufeffticket_id;summary;owner\r\n'
        '42;"修复;他说 ""现在""\n重试";张三\r\n'
        'T-2;无 owner;\r\n'
    ).encode("utf-8")
    assert export_tickets(rows) == expected


def test_export_tickets_empty_rows_has_header():
    assert export_tickets([]) == "\ufeffticket_id;summary;owner\r\n".encode("utf-8")
